title: Pumpkin Seed Daily Dose Myth

scenes.text: Can you safely eat 150 grams of pumpkin seeds each day?
Eating 150 g of pumpkin seeds daily is safe for everyone.
scenes.label: 150g safe for all

scenes.text: Even a modest handful supplies nutrients; excess adds calories and high omega‑6 fats that can upset balance.
scenes.label: Too much adds calories

scenes.text: Stick to a handful (≈30 g) daily.
scenes.label: Handful limit

scenes.text: Follow for daily tips to feel your best.

description: A popular belief says you can munch a cup of pumpkin seeds daily. The evidence shows a small handful is enough for benefits without extra calories. Follow for more evidence‑based nutrition hacks.
